context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for the axios 401 interceptor confirmed working end-to-end on /login. Interceptor correctly skips redirect for auth endpoints and for the /login path; AuthPage shows its own error toast. No regressions on the happy path.
rca of the issue: Original: a global axios response interceptor in App.js redirected any 401 to '/?session_expired=true', catching wrong-password login 401s and bouncing the user off /login before AuthPage could surface the toast. Fix (verified): interceptor now returns early when error.config.url matches /api/auth/(login|admin-login|school-login|signup|register) and when the current path is /login, allowing AuthPage's catch block to display toast.error(message) while keeping the user on /login.
